Name: NOP
Description: Does nothing

Name: HALT
Description: Ends the program

Name: EQ
Description: Returns 1 if operands are equal, returns 0 otherwise

Name: LE
Description: Returns 1 if operand 1 <= operand 2, returns 0 otherwise

Name: AND
Description: Returns the bitwise AND of operands 1 and 2

Name: OR
Description: Returns the bitwise OR of operands 1 and 2

Name: XOR
Description: Returns the bitwise XOR of operands 1 and 2

Name: NOT
Description: Returns the bitwise NOT of operand 1

Name: ADD
Description: Returns operand 1 + operand 2

Name: SUB
Description: Returns operand 1 - operand 2

Name: MUL
Description: Returns operand 1 * operand 2

Name: DIV
Description: Returns operand 1 / operand 2

Name: MOD
Description: Returns operand 1 % operand 2

Name: NEG
Description: Returns -operand 1

Name: SHL
Description: Returns operand 1 shifted left by operand 2 bits

Name: SHR
Description: Returns operand 1 shifted right by operand 2 bits

Name: LI
Description: Returns the 22 LSBs of the instruction

Name: LOAD
Description: Returns the data stored at memory location Addr Reg + Addr Imm

Name: STORE
Description: Stores the data kept in the source register at memory location Addr Reg + Addr Imm

Name: JUMP
Description: Sets program counter to Base Reg + Addr Imm

Name: BRZ
Description: Sets program counter to Base Reg + Addr Imm if source register is 1, does nothing otherwise

Name: BRNZ
Description: Sets program countrer to Base Reg + Addr Imm if source register is 0, does nothing otherwise
